Easy.question: A friend says "all even numbers are multiples of 4". Explain why they are wrong.
Easy.working:
Working:
Even numbers only need to divide evenly by 2. For example, 6 is even, but 6 ÷ 4 leaves a remainder, so 6 is not a multiple of 4. Multiples of 4 are a smaller group inside the even numbers, like 4, 8, 12, 16.

Easy.question:
Two straight lines cross at a point, forming four angles.

Find the other three angles (list all three).
Easy.working:

The angle vertically opposite 119° is also 119° (vertically opposite angles are equal).
The two angles adjacent to it lie on a straight line with it: 180° - 119° = 61° each.
The other three angles are 119°, 61° and 61°.

Hard.question:
A triangle has two angles of 28° and 63°.
Find the third angle, then classify the triangle as Acute, Right, or Obtuse.
Hard.working:
Working:
Third angle = 180° - 28° - 63° = 89°
The three angles are 28°, 63° and 89°.
The largest angle is 89°, so the triangle is Acute.

Hard.question:
Two straight lines cross at a point, forming four angles.
One of the angles is 119°.
Find the other three angles (list all three).
Hard.working:
Working:
The angle vertically opposite 119° is also 119° (vertically opposite angles are equal).
The two angles adjacent to it lie on a straight line with it: 180° - 119° = 61° each.
The other three angles are 119°, 61° and 61°.
